title: paginate skips and mislabels pages
prompt: Bug report: paginate(items, page, size) in src/paginate.js is wrong. Pages are meant to be 1-based, but page 1 returns the second chunk of items. Also the returned totalPages looks off when the last page is only partly full, and asking for a page past the end blows up instead of just giving back an empty page. Throw a RangeError when size is less than 1 or when page is less than 1.
